scheme.notes: Structure (papers, groups, sections) from the ICAI syllabus page https://www.icai.org/post/syllabus-nset-intermediate. Chapters and topics extracted from the ICAI paper PDFs (links per paper in source_url and docs/syllabus-sources/ca-pdf-links.json; local copies in docs/syllabus-sources/ca/). Chapter = numbered content item of the paper; topic = its sub-item, with deeper levels written as 'Parent: item'; the Section or Part (with marks) is in the chapter's section field. ICAI does not publish marks per chapter, so chapter weights are empty. Papers published as two PDFs are merged into one paper. Paper 1 chapter 3 has no title in the source; its name was derived from its sub-items. Paper 2 (Corporate and Other Laws) lists its Companies Act chapters as a numbered list under one item, so they are topics of 'The Companies Act, 2013'. Needs editor review before publishing.
